from __future__ import division from enigma import eSize, ePoint, getDesktop
# Offsets and minimums offset_listposx = 20 offset_listwidth = 20 offset_listheight = 72 offset_textwidth = 131 offset_textheight = 60 min_width = 1280 min_height = 100 offset = 60
# Desktop size deskwidth = getDesktop(0).size().width() deskheight = getDesktop(0).size().height()
# Text widget size
textsize = self["text"].getSize() textwidth = textsize[0] + offset_textwidth textheight = textsize[1] + offset_textheight
textwidth = max(textwidth, min_width) textheight = max(textheight, min_height)
# List widget size listwidth = 0 listheight = 0 if self.list: try: longest_item = max(len(i[0]) for i in self.list) listwidth = longest_item * offset_listwidth listheight = len(self.list) * offset_listheight except Exception as e: print("*** list size error ***", e)
# Constrain list height maxheight = int(deskheight * 0.75) - textheight - (offset_textheight * 3) if listheight > maxheight: listheight = maxheight
# Window width if textwidth > listwidth: wsizex = textwidth + (offset_listposx * 3) else: textwidth = listwidth wsizex = listwidth + (offset_listposx * 3)
# Window height wsizey = textheight + listheight
# Ensure not wider than screen if wsizex > deskwidth: textwidth = 2400 listwidth = 2400
# Apply window size wsize = (wsizex, wsizey) self.instance.resize(eSize(*wsize))
# Resize text widget self["text"].instance.resize(eSize(textwidth, textheight))
# Move and resize list widget if self.list: text_pos = self["text"].getPosition() text_size = self["text"].getSize() new_y = text_pos[1] + text_size[1] + offset listsize = (wsizex - (offset_listposx * 3), listheight) self["list"].instance.move(ePoint(offset_listposx, new_y)) self["list"].instance.resize(eSize(*listsize))
# Center window newwidth = wsize[0] newheight = wsize[1] self.instance.move(ePoint(int((deskwidth - newwidth) // 2), int((deskheight - newheight) // 2) ))

from enigma import getDesktop, eSize, ePoint margin = 0 separator = 40 desktop_w = getDesktop(0).size().width() desktop_h = getDesktop(0).size().height() itemheight = 72
textsize = (0, 0) if self["text"].text: textsize = self["text"].getSize() if textsize[0] < textsize[1]: textsize = (textsize[1], textsize[0] + 13)
listcount = 0
listLen = len(self.list) listMaxItems = int(desktop_h * 0.8 - textsize[1]) // itemheight scrollbar = 13
# maxWidth = desktop_w * 0.9 # minWidth = desktop_w // 2
listWidth = self["list"].instance.size().width() try: listWidth = int(min(self["list"].instance.getMaxItemTextWidth() + scrollbar, desktop_w * 0.9)) except Exception as e: print(e)
count = min(listLen, listMaxItems) if textsize[1] and textsize[0] < listWidth: textsize = (listWidth, textsize[1]) width = max(listWidth, textsize[0]) listsize = (width, listMaxItems * itemheight) listPos = separator + textsize[1] if textsize[1] > 0 else margin # resize label self["text"].instance.resize(eSize(*textsize)) self["text"].instance.move(ePoint(margin, margin)) # move list self["list"].instance.resize(eSize(*listsize)) self["list"].instance.move(ePoint(margin, listPos))
wsizex = margin * 3 + width wsizey = listPos + (count * itemheight) + margin wsize = (wsizex, wsizey) self.instance.resize(eSize(*wsize))
# center window self.instance.move(ePoint((desktop_w - wsizex) // 2, (desktop_h - wsizey) // 2))
